description: Election Commission - Mr. M. M. Raheem of the Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government matters, specifically addressing the status of an elected official in a local authority, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral-related declarations and office vacancies.
